definitions.gloss: tubers and root starches; the potato family of foods
definitions.explanation: The food category that groups starchy tubers and roots together, including じゃがいも (potato), さつまいも (sweet potato), さといも (taro), and やまいも (yam).

examples.japanese: {芋類|いもるい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{炭水化物|たんすいかぶつ}→炭水化物：06208_tansuikabutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
{芋類|いもるい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{食物繊維|しょくもつせんい}→食物繊維：15118_shokumotsuseni⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{含|ふく}まれている→含む：01982_fukumu⟧。
examples.english: Tubers contain plenty of dietary fiber.

examples.japanese: {芋類|いもるい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{種類|しゅるい}→種類：01560_shurui⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{調理|ちょうり}→調理：07156_chouri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕方|しかた}→仕方：01603_shikata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: How you cook tubers varies greatly depending on the type.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{芋|いも}→芋：10231_imo⟧ (tuber, potato) + ⟦{類|るい}→類：15121_rui⟧ (category, kind). A collective term used in nutrition and cooking to group starchy roots.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {芋類|いもるい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧: to eat tubers
- {芋類|いもるい}⟦{中心|ちゅうしん}→中心：01467_chuushin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧: a tuber-centered diet
- {根菜類|こんさいるい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{芋類|いもるい}: root vegetables and tubers
